title: AK Cluster ID8
description: Custom instrument clusters drawn over the whole iDrive 7 cluster: Toro, after the Lamborghini Huracan; M Sport, BMW M's iDrive 8 M View rebuilt from a reference frame; M Sport Plus, the same dials round the M stripes with a wide picture in the centre; and M Track Mode, BMW M's track view - four gauge rows in a blue wing, the gear, a leaning rev counter. Each style has its own page of settings. Off until you turn it on; BMW's warnings and gear display always stay BMW's.

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: The car's pressure unit: the Sport Display's boost comes in it

de.bmw.infrastructure.VehicleCondition._optional: the car switching on and off: the theme stays off the cluster then

de.bmw.infotainment.displaydataserver.Di._optional: The speed limit the car has read, as the head-up display gets it (Display > Speed limit sign)

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiIF._optional: Fuel range, tank level and odometer; the time of day the cluster shows; the trip computer's average consumption, distance and driving time; electric range

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.Ef._optional: The drive battery's charge and temperature, on a plug-in hybrid or an electric car

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.FE._optional: Boost pressure from the Sport Display, the driving mode, the engine's torque

de.bmw.infotainment.misc.MDrive._optional: Driving mode on M cars; the gearbox's S / M programme

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.CDS2._optional: Lateral and longitudinal load for the G meter

com.harman.infotainment.systemfunctions.._optional: Oil pressure, intake air temperature, battery voltage, fuel pressures, the boost target and the fuel tank level read from the engine unit (read only), for cars without BeeM-Flash
